name: Circle of Aquementas
summary: Travelers come to Tanaris’s eastern shore to summon Aquementas at the Circle of Aquementas.

sections.title: A Ring by the Sea
sections.body: South of Lost Rigger Cove, the Circle of Aquementas stands where Tanaris’s eastern shore meets the desert. Weathered stones rise beside the sea in a ring. Travelers gather here to call Aquementas, an elemental spirit linked to an ancient artifact. Southsea brigands and sea creatures roam the nearby beaches, but the stones mark a place for summoning.

faq.q: What is the Circle of Aquementas?
faq.answer: On Tanaris’s southeastern coast, upright stones form a ring where travelers can summon the elemental spirit Aquementas.

aliases: how to find circle of aquementas
faq.answer: The circle lies on Tanaris’s eastern shore, directly south of the cliffs and entrance to Lost Rigger Cove.
Aquementas is an elemental spirit linked to an ancient artifact, summoned at the circle of stones.

faq.q: Is the circle guarded by pirates?
faq.answer: Southsea pirates prowl near Lost Rigger Cove and the surrounding shore. The circle itself is an isolated place for summoning.

angles.text: As a shaman on the Tanaris coast, you may find the circle’s power to focus primal energies and anchor an elemental spirit intriguing.
